clauses.clause: Whenever this creature ... enters, each opponent mills two cards.
clauses.evidence: [cast] and the flash-in stimulus: card's triggered ability [0] triggers and opp's top two cards (Library 5, Library 4 on the cast) move library -> graveyard, opp library 6 -> 4; seat 0's library is untouched.

clauses.clause: ... or another Rogue you control enters ...
clauses.evidence: no Rogue other than the card enters in the trace (the 'creature enters under your control' stimulus triggers nothing). Packs: K05_1 (another Rogue of mine mills two; a non-Rogue of mine and the opponent's Rogue do not), K05_2 (three players: each opponent mills two), K05_8 (two Rogues entering in one event, put onto the battlefield together by Ugin's [-10] as a supporting card: one trigger each, four cards milled).

clauses.clause: As long as an opponent has eight or more cards in their graveyard, this creature gets +2/+1 and has deathtouch.
clauses.evidence: the static section shows 1/1 with only FLASH: the opponent never has eight cards. Packs: K05_3 (eight: 3/2 deathtouch, kills a 0/9 blocker), K05_4 (seven theirs, ten mine: nothing), K05_5 (three players: one opponent with eight is enough), K05_6 and K05_7 (follows the graveyard as it changes).

survived: each occurrence -> once per event at 1/0
